The '''Bramior star''' was located in<ref name="CRO" /> the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Bramior system/Legends|Bramior system]]. It was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by an expansive [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] and, eons before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Star/Legends|star]] also [[Gravity/Legends|captured]] the large [[rogue moon]] [[Rove]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of that conflict, the luxury [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] [[Cal-class battleship|starship]] ''[[Cal Ambre]]'' occupied a permanent orbit in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] as well, being situated at the edge of the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] field.<ref name="CRO" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bramior star was created by [[Paul Sudlow]] and was introduced in ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a [[1994]] [[West End Games]] sourcebook published for use with ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="CRO" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Bramior system, and therefore the star, in grid square M-9.<ref name="TEA" />
